description.en: Creates a detailed (Hi) model of the NPC cnNNNN: CMND_CREATE_CHARA(5, _charaName, set, _npc_no, true, false, _no_base, _mem), with set "Talk" when _talk is true.
Name of the new object; the events use the character's name followed by L (light model) or H (detailed model).
NPC number: the model is cnNNNN.
true for the "Talk" motion set (talking model), false for "dmy".
Passed as CMND_CREATE_CHARA's noBase flag (effect not traced).
Handle of the new character (see CMND_CREATE_CHARA).

examples.case: A detailed NPC model (real usage, from ev42010600.nut; the Shift-JIS object name is replaced by a variable here)
